name: Deore LX 9-speed 11–32T cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 1999 reference: 350 g for the Deore LX CS-HG70-9 nine-speed 11–32T cassette. The exact model and ar tooth sequence are identified in the same manual’s LX service table.
